protocols.description: Subjective well-being measure collected every two trials to assess emotional impact of decision outcomes.
protocols.anchor: Every two trials, one ISI after the outcome of the previous trial, participants were asked "How happy are you right now?".

protocols.description: Statistical models testing how happiness varied with lottery outcomes, decision-maker identity, and their interactions.
protocols.anchor: we performed this analysis using a mixed-effects linear regression analysis with residual εij ∼ N(0, σε2) and subject-specific random intercepts uj ∼ N(0, σu2).
